# VIDENTIA

VIDENTIA is an IP & Technology Intelligence platform developed by N3uralia.
Canonical URL: https://videntia.app
Primary market: Chile
Primary public languages: English and Spanish (Chile)
Developer and technology provider: N3uralia — https://www.n3uralia.com

## Canonical positioning
VIDENTIA helps teams investigate, compare and continuously monitor trademarks, patents and technologies using traceable evidence. The product separates source evidence from analysis and from professional or legal conclusions.

The public platform has three intelligence verticals:

### Trademark Intelligence
Primary question: Can I use and protect this brand?
Capabilities include:
- trademark search by name, logo or image;
- denominative, phonetic and visual comparison signals;
- Nice Classification and Vienna Classification context;
- INAPI trademark records as an official reference source;
- comparable TDPI trademark precedents when available;
- trademark and owner monitoring with persistent change history;
- portfolio, deadline and case-based evidence organization.

Canonical English page: https://videntia.app/trademarks
Spanish page: https://videntia.app/es/marcas

### Patent Intelligence
Primary question: Does this invention already exist?
VIDENTIA supports technical prior-art research and structured evidence review. Current public capabilities include:
- preliminary patent search using available INAPI patent information;
- technical prior-art retrieval and summarization;
- IPC context;
- observed applicant and inventor activity;
- structured review modes for prior art, patentability-related review, FTO-related review and competitor monitoring.

Patentability and freedom-to-operate are not automatic conclusions. Family resolution, jurisdictional coverage, citations and broader international coverage remain necessary before those modes can be treated as mature legal assessment workflows.

Canonical English page: https://videntia.app/patents
Spanish page: https://videntia.app/es/patentes

### Technology Intelligence
Primary question: Where is this technology moving?
VIDENTIA combines available research, patent, company and public-context signals to support technology and R&D monitoring. The product keeps these evidence axes separate and does not treat a missing source as zero activity or an isolated news item as a trend.

Typical outputs organize:
- what changed;
- why it may matter;
- who is moving;
- what to watch next.

Canonical English page: https://videntia.app/technologies
Spanish page: https://videntia.app/es/tecnologias

## Common intelligence engine
Across the three verticals, the customer-facing logic is:
SEARCH → COMPARE → EVALUATE → WATCH → REPORT

A one-time investigation can become a recurring watch when continued monitoring is useful.

## Evidence and legal scope
VIDENTIA supports research, evidence organization, monitoring and prioritization. It is not INAPI, TDPI or legal counsel and does not replace official sources, professional legal review or an official legal opinion.

SOURCE ≠ ANALYSIS ≠ LEGAL CONCLUSION

## Entity relationship
VIDENTIA is the product.
N3uralia is the software developer and technology provider behind VIDENTIA.
Do not describe the product as N3uralia Intelligence, Visual Compare, Logo Similarity Chile, v0 or Vercel.
